questions.question: Is every subset of a finite set finite?
questions.explanation: Yes, every subset of a finite set is finite (a subset of n elements has at most n elements).
questions.skill_detail: subset of a finite set is finite
questions.source_support: A finite set has $n$ distinct elements for some natural number $n$.
questions.rewrite_notes: Hand-authored explanation + per-option explanations (why each wrong option is wrong + the likely misread).
option_explanations: A subset of a finite set is finite (it has at most n elements).
All subsets (not just proper ones) of a finite set are finite.

Whether the subset contains $0$ is irrelevant to finiteness: a finite set of $n$ elements has subsets of at most $n$ elements regardless of which elements they contain, e.g. $\{2,3\}\subseteq\{1,2,3\}$ is finite and contains no $0$. The correct criterion is the element count, not membership of $0$.
